items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: He was with me. I got him out of Detroit. He was with me for quite a while.

ctx.x: He took Bobby Smith's place. There were a couple of bass players. I can't recall their name cause Stanfield passed soon. Oh, Kelly Martin. You know, Kelly Martin was with me also with the big band, too, for awhile also before he went with the "Misty" man.
Right. Right. He was with me. I got him out of Detroit. He was with me for quite a while.
